documents.name: Privacy Policy
documents.text:
Privacy Policy — Part 1

What the software collects, and why

Ferrum collects only the information needed to run Echo and Ferrum Computer, keep accounts secure, provide the features in your tier, and improve the software. If a piece of information is not needed for one of those purposes, the software should not collect it.

Account information

Your name or display name, email address, account identifier, subscription tier, and sign-in details. Passwords are stored only in protected, hashed form — never in plain text. This information creates and secures your account and confirms which tier and credits belong to you.

Subscription, coupon, and credit records

Your tier, billing status, coupon generation and redemption records, and your credit balance and credit use. Payment card details are handled by the payment provider and are not stored in full by Ferrum. These records are needed to bill correctly, prevent coupon misuse, and show you an accurate balance.

Content you create with the software

Prompts, projects, files, settings, and work you create or open in Echo, Echo Studio, and Ferrum Computer, to the extent needed to provide the feature you used — for example, running a model, saving a project, or syncing through Windows Bridge when your tier includes it and you turn it on.

Device and technical information

Device type, operating system, software version, crash and error reports, performance data, and security signals such as sign-in attempts. This information is used to fix faults, keep the software working on supported computers, and detect abuse.

Feedback Center submissions

Anything you send through a Feedback Center — bug reports, feature requests, screenshots, and support messages — along with the account and device details needed to investigate. Do not include passwords or payment card numbers in feedback.

What the software does not do: It does not sell your personal information. It does not collect your contacts, messages, photos, or files from outside the software unless you choose to bring them into a feature that needs them. Linux runs inside the Ferrum Computer software only; the software does not install Linux into Windows or change your Windows system outside the software.

Privacy Policy — Part 2

Sharing, retention, security, and your choices

When information is shared

• Service providers who host, process payments for, secure, or support the software, only for the work they do for Ferrum and under confidentiality duties.

• Legal duties — when the law requires it, or to protect users, Ferrum, or the public from fraud, abuse, or serious harm.

• At your direction — when you export, share, publish, or sync something yourself.

• A business change — if Ferrum is ever sold or merged, information may transfer with the business, and you will be notified before a different policy applies.

How long information is kept

Account and subscription records are kept while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterward for billing, security, and legal records. Content you delete is removed from active systems within a reasonable period, except where a copy must be kept for security, dispute, or legal reasons. Credit and coupon records are kept long enough to prevent fraud and resolve billing questions.

Security

Ferrum uses access controls, encryption in transit, and limited employee access. No system is perfectly secure, so you should use a strong, unique password, keep your sign-in details private, and report any suspicious activity through the Feedback Center right away.

Your choices and rights

• View and update your account information in the software.

• Request a copy of your personal information, correction of errors, or deletion of your account, subject to records Ferrum must keep by law.

• Turn off optional features, such as Windows Bridge sync, in settings.

• Opt out of non-essential marketing messages at any time. Service messages about billing, security, and policy changes will still be sent.

Children

The paid software is not directed to children under 13, and accounts for children under 13 should not be created. If you believe a child under 13 has provided personal information, contact Ferrum through the Feedback Center so it can be reviewed and removed.

Cookies and similar tools

Any Ferrum website for the software may use cookies that are needed to sign you in, remember settings, and measure use. You can control cookies in your browser; turning off required cookies may stop sign-in or checkout from working.

documents.name: Subscription Agreement
documents.text:
Subscription Agreement

• Free first. Every user starts on the free tier. No charge is made until you choose a paid tier and confirm the purchase.

• Prices. Premium is $20, Pro is $30, and Max is $50, at the billing period shown at checkout. Taxes may apply. The price shown at checkout is the price you agree to.

• Renewal and billing. Paid subscriptions renew at the end of each billing period unless cancelled before renewal, and you authorize the payment provider to charge your payment method for renewals.

• Credits — Echo only. Premium includes 200 Echo credits, Pro includes 10,000, and Max includes 20,000 when Echo is released. Credits apply only inside Echo; they do not apply to Ferrum Computer. They have no cash value, cannot be transferred or sold, and do not convert to money. How each Echo feature spends credits will be shown in the software. Your Echo credit allowance resets weekly, on the weekend, at 12 midnight, and your subscription renews at that same moment.

• Hard stop at zero credits. When your Echo credits are used up, Echo will tell you that you cannot use any more Echo features because you have to pay your Echo subscription bill. Echo features pause until that bill is paid. This is a hard stop, not pay-as-you-go: Echo does not keep running features and charge per use after credits reach zero.

• Upgrades and downgrades. You may change tier in the software. Upgrades take effect as shown at checkout; downgrades normally take effect at the next billing period, with credits and features then following the new tier.

• Cancellation. You may cancel at any time. Paid access normally continues until the end of the period paid for, then the account returns to the free tier. Fees paid are non-refundable except where the law requires a refund or Ferrum states otherwise in writing.

• Failed payments. If a payment fails, Ferrum may retry it, ask for a new payment method, and move the account to the free tier until payment succeeds.

• Feature changes. Ferrum may add features at any time. If a material feature is removed from a paid tier, subscribers will be notified in advance when reasonably possible.

documents.name: Coupon Agreement
documents.text:
Coupon Agreement — including the welcome coupon

• Generated for you. When you first open the software, a coupon is generated for your account carrying 100% off for the first two weeks of the paid tier you choose at redemption, as shown on the coupon itself.

• One coupon, one account. The welcome coupon is one per person and per account, is tied to the account it was generated for, and cannot be transferred, sold, copied, or combined with another coupon unless the coupon itself says so.

• Expiry and redemption. Redeem the coupon before its expiry date. After the two-week period ends, the regular price and normal renewal terms apply unless you cancel first.

• Misuse. Coupons obtained or used by fraud or misuse may be cancelled, and related accounts may be limited.

• No cash value. A coupon cannot be exchanged for money or credits unless it expressly says so.

documents.name: Software Terms
documents.text:
Software Terms

Using Echo and Ferrum Computer fairly

Your license

Ferrum grants you a personal, non-transferable license to install and use Echo and Ferrum Computer for your own work while your account is in good standing and, for paid features, while your subscription is active. You may not copy, resell, sublicense, or rent the software itself, or work around tier, credit, or coupon limits.

Your work stays yours

You keep ownership of the original content and projects you create with the software. You give Ferrum only the permission needed to run the features you use — for example, to process, store, display, and sync your work inside the software. Ferrum keeps ownership of the software, its models, Echo Studio, and the Ferrum brand and designs.

Acceptable use

• Do not use the software to break the law, infringe another person's rights, harass or harm others, or create or spread malware.

• Do not try to access another user's account or data, probe or overload Ferrum systems, or bypass security, credit, or tier controls.

• Do not use automated access that is not provided by the software itself.

• You are responsible for your account activity and for checking that anything you publish or send with the software is lawful and accurate.

Updates and availability

Ferrum may update the software to add features, fix faults, and improve security. Updates are delivered through the software. If an update ever requires a restart, the software will notify you on the computer itself. Ferrum works to keep Echo and Ferrum Computer available, but does not promise uninterrupted service; maintenance, faults, and events outside Ferrum's control can cause pauses.

Limits of liability

To the fullest extent allowed by law, the software is provided “as is,” and Ferrum is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for loss of data caused by your own device, network, or failure to keep backups. Nothing in this section removes rights that cannot be removed by law. Keep your own backups of important projects.

documents.name: Feedback Centers
documents.text:
Help and Feedback

Feedback Centers and anything else you need

Feedback Centers are built into the software so help is in the same place as the problem.

Bug and fault reports Report crashes, errors, and things that do not work. Include what you were doing, what happened, and a screenshot if you can. Reports go to review as tickets.

Feature requests Suggest a feature or a change. Requests are recorded for review; sending a request does not guarantee it will be built, and Echo does not redesign or reprogram itself from feedback.

Billing and subscriptions Questions about tiers, charges, credits, refunds, and coupons — including a coupon that did not generate or did not redeem.

Privacy and account help Requests to view, correct, export, or delete your information, report a security concern, or get help signing in.

What happens after you send feedback

• You receive a confirmation that the submission was received.

• Urgent security and billing problems are prioritized over feature requests.

• Ferrum may reply to ask for more detail. Keep the original submission number if one is shown.

• Do not send passwords, full payment card numbers, or another person's private information in feedback.

Changes to this document

Ferrum may update this document as the software changes. Material changes will be announced in the software before they take effect, with the version and date updated at the front. Continuing to use the software after a change takes effect means you accept it. If you do not accept a change, cancel any paid subscription before it takes effect.

General terms

If any part of this document is found unenforceable, the rest still applies. Failure to enforce a term once does not waive it. This is the agreement between you and Ferrum for the software, subscriptions, credits, and coupons, unless a separate signed agreement says otherwise.

Before launch: This working draft, written from Ferrum's approved subscription model, should be reviewed by a qualified business attorney before it is published as binding terms.
